calculation.description: Cross-sectional sign inversion of downside-risk-adjusted 60-day and 120-day momentum. Lower continuation scores receive higher reversal scores, expressing mean reversion while controlling each horizon by downside volatility. Ranks are computed across the available 15 tradable benchmark instruments on each date.

validation.regime_notes: Positive across early, middle, and recent regimes at the 10-day horizon, although recent predictive strength is modest. The 40-day relationship remains positive overall but reverses in the recent regime; use primarily at the 10-day decision horizon and interpret uncertainty conservatively for the 15-instrument cross-section.
